question: Select the most appropriate option for blank (2)
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 4.**

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word "**used**" means employed for a purpose. (उपयोग किया गया)
 
• Example: This tool is used for cutting metal.
 
• In the context, "Oil-based products such as gasoline, diesel fuel, and aviation fuel provide most of the energy used in transportation" means that these products are utilized for transportation purposes.

​Therefore, the correct answer is '**used**'.

**Complete Sentence:** *Coal and natural gas-fired power plants generate electricity. Oil-based products such as gasoline, diesel fuel, and aviation fuel provide most of the energy **used**__ in transportation. *

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Useless (बेकार)**: Not fulfilling or not expected to achieve the intended purpose or desired outcome.

 
 
• **Example: **This old computer is useless for modern software applications.
 
 
 
• **Until (तक)**: Up to the point in time or the event mentioned.
 
 
• **Example: **We waited until the rain stopped.
 
 
 
• **Is using (प्रयोग कर रहा है)**: Denotes an ongoing action of utilizing something in the present.
 
 
• **Example: **She is using her phone to browse the internet.
